page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with the running head at the top, the page number at top right, the gathering signature at bottom centre and the catchword at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: aeqvieverint , Melchitæ dicti sunt & hactenus hoc nomine dignoscuntur,qva-si dicas imperiales seu Regii ; qvi verò non , & Mardaitarum, seu rebellium, & Maronitarum nomen retinuere ; hac-qve de causa multa prælia cum Justini-ani ducibus inierunt, ut præter Maroni-tarum testantur Melchitarum , Jacobita-rum , aliarumqve gentium orientalium monumenta ; nec profectò ab avita vir-tute, aut Religione degenerârunt Maro-nitarum posteri etiam sub immani Tur-carum jugo ; etenim illi soli inter omnes Orientales Christianas gentes arma tra-ctant & Catholicam profitentur fidem ; bellicæ virtutis præclarissimum testimo-nium nobis facit præliū illud, qvod ante biennium illatum est á Prorege Damasci Amiro ( ut de antiqvioribus nihil nunc dicam ) in qvo Amiri acies, qvæ ex diversis componebatur gentibus, Tur-carum multitudine, ac numero pene op-pressa jamjam in fugam inclinaverat, ni-si noftrorum Maronitarum incredibilis ac invicti animi magnitudo gravissima

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side and a few specks in the left margin were ignored. The word "praeliū" has a macron-like mark over the u that is not fully clear; it is copied as it appears. The spelling "qvi", "qvae", "qvod" is kept as printed. The line break in "Melchitæ" and "dignoscuntur,qva-si" follows the printed spacing.
